When we talk about “Article-5-like” guarantees, we need answers to some very clear questions. Which countries will support Ukraine if Ukraine is attacked again? All NATO countries are already interested in the experience Ukrainian soldiers have gained. With our operations on land, at sea, and in the air, Ukrainians have shown that our Defense Forces are very effective. And we can share this experience and make it part of NATO’s own experience.

Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares for each Zscaler share, about $260.41 apiece. That’s a roughly 34% premium to Zscaler’s Nov. 20 close. CrowdStrike holders will own about 84% of the combined company, and Zscaler holders about 16%.

Zscaler founder and CEO Jay Chaudhry will keep running the Zscaler business and join CrowdStrike’s board. He and his affiliates, who own about 34% of Zscaler, have agreed to vote for the deal.

posts.text:
Korean media report that Samsung plans to add a production line capable of processing 20,000 wafers per month at its X2 NAND flash fab in Xi’an, China, bringing the fab to its full production capacity.

X2 currently produces 100,000 V6 NAND wafers and 10,000 V9 NAND wafers per month. The fab can handle up to 130,000 wafers per month.

Samsung plans to dedicate the new line entirely to V9 and convert 20–30% of its existing V6 capacity to V9 production. The expansion and conversion would raise X2’s V9 capacity to 50,000–60,000 wafers per month.

Samsung plans to build an electroplating line in unused cleanroom space at X2, with equipment move-in expected around February 2027. The company plans to send engineers from its South Korean operations to Xi’an with the aim of completing the expansion by November 2027.
